_instructions: Label real invoices by hand in the same format as eval/dataset/labels/*.json.
Put the documents next to this file. They are git-ignored: real invoices contain personal and financial data.
Values are what is PRINTED, normalised: money as a plain decimal string ('1234.50'), dates as ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD', currency as an ISO code ('BDT', 'USD', 'EUR'). Use null for anything not printed.
List ambiguous numeric dates (e.g. 04/05/2026) in ambiguous_fields; the label holds the date you know is right.
expected_flags: the validation issues a correct system should raise (codes as in docs/evaluation.md).
split: 'dev' to tune on, 'test' to report on. Run with: make eval REAL=1

notes: replace this example with your own invoices
